method: Targeted web searches across the 100 requested domains, plus broader searches for active competitions.
Follow concrete results to official event, rules and contest-listing pages. Stop when a search yields no concrete lead.
Check Indian entry and cash-prize eligibility, explicit AI permission, cash above USD 200, and the entry deadline. Keep unconfirmed leads separate.
Record official links, prize conflicts and IST deadlines; deduplicate repeated announcements. This is a dated research snapshot, not continuous coverage of the entire internet.
